description: This Java source file defines a class ProtocolMessageExtractor which implements a function to parse WebSocket protocol messages. It extracts and interprets messages related to streaming control (such as start, stop, and JWT tokens), based on predefined message types. The class handles parameter parsing from protocol message strings, including URL decoding, and constructs corresponding streaming control message objects.

classes.name: ProtocolMessageExtractor
classes.description: A final class implementing Function<String, Optional<StreamControlMessage>> that extracts and constructs streaming control messages from WebSocket protocol payload strings.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Given a protocol message string, determines the message type and creates the corresponding StreamControlMessage (StartStreaming, StopStreaming, Jwt) object wrapped in an Optional.

methods.name: getProtocolMessageType
methods.description: Identifies the ProtocolMessageType based on the message string prefix.

methods.name: getJwt
methods.description: Extracts JWT token from message parameters and creates a Jwt object.

methods.name: determineParams
methods.description: Parses the protocol message for URL parameters and returns a Map of key-value pairs.

methods.name: urlDecode
methods.description: Decodes URL-encoded strings with UTF-8 charset, with fallback to default decoding.

methods.name: getStartStreaming
methods.description: Constructs a StartStreaming object based on message parameters and streaming type.

methods.name: getNamespaces
methods.description: Splits the 'namespaces' parameter into a list of strings.

methods.name: getExtraFields
methods.description: Creates a JsonFieldSelector for additional fields specified in parameters, or returns null if none.

methods.name: getStopStreaming
methods.description: Creates a StopStreaming object for the specified streaming type.
